question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Rely
solution: The correct answer is '**Distrust**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Rely**' is '**Distrust**'. • **Rely**: to trust somebody/something to work or behave well. [किसी पर भरोसा या विश्‍वास करना (किसी काम के लिए)] • *Example: Can I **rely** on you to keep a secret?* • **Distrust**: the feeling that you cannot believe somebody/something; a lack of trust. (किसी पर भरोसा न कर सकने का भाव; अविश्‍वास) • *Example: She **distrusts** him because he lied to her once before.* **Correct Answer:__** *Distrust.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Await**: to wait for somebody/something. (किसी की प्रतीक्षा करना) • **Depend**: be able to trust; rely on. (भरोसा करने में सक्षम हो; पर भरोसा) • **Move**: to change position or to put something in a different position. (स्‍थान बदलना या किसी वस्‍तु को अन्‍य स्‍थान पर ले जाना, हिलना या हिलाना; खिसकना या खिसकाना) 3a:T816, The erroneous part is **'It was a surprising'.**
